cover_trend_note: Hard coral cover %; literature-anchored, shows 2024 bleaching dip and partial 2025 recovery.

bleaching_events.note: 2nd global mass bleaching event; Malaysia DHW ~5.2 (Tun et al. 2013)
3rd global bleaching event (2014-2017 El Nino peak)
4th global bleaching event; Apr-Jun 2024, ~90% of surveyed Malaysian sites affected (Reef Check Malaysia 2026)

image_legend.mild: Partial bleaching: central colony white, surrounding tissue still pigmented
image_legend.moderate: Extensive pale/bleached field, some pigment retained
image_legend.severe: Fully bleached/white skeleton, high mortality risk

provenance_note: RHI components and cover trend are literature-anchored estimates for the Semporna archipelago (NOT in-situ survey data). Bleaching events and DHW values cite Reef Check Malaysia (2026), NOAA CRW, and published Malaysia bleaching literature. Coral images are reference illustrations; see img/coral/SOURCES.md for attribution.
